definitions.explanation: Describes something that has a large extent or area. The opposite of {狭|せま}い (narrow). Used for rooms, roads, areas, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広|ひろ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This room is spacious, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {広|ひろ}い⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}きましょう→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: Let's walk on the wide road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広|ひろ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{広|ひろ}い⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: There's a large parking lot in front of the station, so it's convenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広|ひろ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→たち：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}ったり→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだり→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This park is spacious, so on weekends families come and the children run around and play.

notes:
{広|ひろ}い is an i-adjective meaning wide, spacious, or broad.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {広|ひろ}く (widely)
- Noun form: ⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧ (width, spaciousness)
- Verb: ⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ (to widen - transitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: spacious room
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: wide road
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧: large garden
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: wide range

FIGURATIVE USES:
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: broad-minded, generous
- {広|ひろ}い⟦{視野|しや}→視野：08659_shiya⟧: broad perspective
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{広|ひろ}い: well-connected (lit: has a wide face)

OPPOSITE:
⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧: narrow, cramped

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：noentry⟧: vast, extensive
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：noentry⟧: broad, wide-ranging
